headline: OpenAI rolls out visual ads appearing during ChatGPT image generation in the US
summary: OpenAI is testing a new visual ad format that shows sponsored products and services on screen when users generate images in ChatGPT, starting in the US later this month. The company first introduced ChatGPT ads in February; outlets differ on whether this format has already launched or is still rolling out.
